title: Create Grid With Exactly K Paths I
summary: Inputs m,n,k fix the output dimensions. Return an array of m strings, each length n, containing only . and #. A path uses only free cells, starts top-left, ends bottom-right, and moves right or down. Exactly k distinct paths must exist. Return [] only when no valid grid exists. Any valid grid is accepted; no prescribed construction is part of the requirements.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
clarification: Authored example: m=3,n=2,k=3 permits ["..","..",".."], whose paths are RDD, DRD, DDR. With m=2,n=1,k=3, return [] because even the fully open grid has only one path.
